scope: Native simulator screenshots of isolated synthetic game state; no physical-device or full native acceptance is claimed.
capture_stage: Mixed: 01–07 are intermediate native-build observations; 08 is the final integrated native build after the 69-test run. See each capture stage.
metadata_notes: File modification timestamps are read from the local filesystem and normalized to UTC; they are not independently recorded action timestamps.
Dimensions are raw PNG pixel dimensions, not an assumed Flutter logical viewport. Landscape content remains in the original capture pixel orientation.
Device names and exercised flow descriptions are attributed to the integrating owner; visible state was separately inspected by the documentation reviewer.
Images are unmodified; SHA-256 identifies the exact local evidence file.
